title.en: Music generation models need finer-grained text descriptions

summary.en: A guess: music generation models are behind language and video models mainly because they lack fine-grained text descriptions. The most feasible way forward is to have agents produce synthetic data at scale.

title.zh: 音乐生成模型需要更细粒度的文本描述

summary.zh: 一个猜测：音乐生成模型落后于语言和视频模型，主要是因为缺少细粒度的文本描述；而最可行的出路，是让 agent 大规模生产合成数据。
